opacity._comment: Keys are the value*100 percentage as an integer (0.07 -> "7") except "018": "1.8" would be the literal convention, but Style Dictionary's Android name/camel transform strips the '.' before joining path segments, colliding "opacity.1.8" and "opacity.18" into the same generated Kotlin property name (opacity18) — confirmed via a real build, not assumed. The leading zero keeps this one visually/numerically distinct with no such collision.
